title: The Spherical Grünbaum Inequality
summary: We prove an analogue of Grünbaum's inequality on the sphere. Let $n \geq 3$ and let $K$ be a convex body on $\mathbb S^{n-1}\subset \mathbb R^n$ with centroid at $θ\in \mathbb S^{n-1}$. Then for any $u\in \mathbb S^{n-1}$ that is orthogonal to $θ$ we have $$σ(K\cap u^+) \ge \left(1-\frac{1}{n}\right)^{n-1} σ(K),$$ where $σ$ denotes the spherical measure. The constant in this inequality is optimal.
